original_organism.premise: Pairs of Mahler-measure subsets (by degree, by class: Salem/Pisot, Smyth-extremal, narrow M-bands, Lehmer neighbourhood) may share a spacing profile; a rank correlation that SURVIVES mean-spacing normalization is a numerical coincidence worth a battery test, one that only exists before normalization is a scale artifact. Charter role (daemon.py header, AGENT_AUTOPSIES): be Hecate's second non-Theseus generator so the cross-generator MI can become non-zero.
original_organism.mechanism: Per tick: pick one pair from a rotation (v0.6: 4 SEED_PAIRS + 5 CANDIDATE_POOL, replace a pair after 5 consecutive identical PROMOTED/REJECTED verdicts), load both subsets via _load_subset (7 selectors over mahler.py), truncate the larger to the n smallest values, corr_raw = Spearman(sorted(a)[:n], sorted(b)[:n]), corr_norm = Spearman of the mean-spacing-normalized arrays, _classify by thresholds (CORR_SIGNIFICANT 0.30, CORR_FLIPPED_DELTA 0.20) into 4 kill_patterns -> PROMOTED / REJECTED / UNVERIFIED; write a kill_ledger.jsonl row in Theseus shape, an artifacts/scan_*.md, an agora intelligence_outputs row; PROMOTED pairs appended to the Stygian priority queue.

contradictory_evidence: AGAINST the design-error reading: the statistic Pollux intended (correlation of spacing profiles between two subsets) can be made well-defined - the normalized leg IS defined and non-degenerate (T3) - so a Cleric may argue this is INSTRUMENT_ERROR (one bad leg) plus MEASUREMENT_ERROR (no null), with the design intact. The Necromancer's answer: the design specified no pairing relation between subsets of different size and hard-coded a truncation ('n smallest of the larger') that T5 shows decides the verdict; that is a design fault the instrument fix would not repair. Recorded as portability defect 1.

AGAINST NO_FAIR_TEST_ON_RECORD and FOR MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: the 06-24 tautology finding, now executed (T1/T2), is exactly a measurement failure, and the charter's MEASUREMENT_ERROR example ('a metric that carries its own answer') describes corr_raw = 1 literally; SCHEMA's 'proximate cause' points at the layer nearest the outcome. The Keeper's answer: the charter defines NO_FAIR_TEST_ON_RECORD as 'the historical experiment could not have answered its own question', which is DESIGN_ERROR's definition, and T2 shows the constant leg is implementation-independent -- a correct raw leg under the same pairing/truncation/no-null design would still emit verdicts inside their own null (N1/N2). The 'deepest load-bearing INVALID' rule the Necromancer cited is not in doctrine and is withdrawn (Cleric C-7; DEFECTS D-83).

AGAINST 'zero consumers used the verdict bit': the Ergon Learner did read every row and its ablation moved a score (0.8092 vs 0.9): but Ergon's own reading (GREEDY_FOLLOWUP_PROGRESS line 50) is that it learned the template, not the verdict, and gold=False on PROMOTED rows means the bit was inverted, not consumed.

AGAINST ECOSYSTEM_FAILURE as a cause of THIS death: Pollux's outputs were unusable before any consumer touched them; the consumer failures would have been fatal for a working Pollux but are not what killed this one. ECOSYSTEM is INVALID on its own evidence, listed as contributing, not primary.

AGAINST the Keeper's EXECUTION VALID: every one of the 286 rows, the two readers' counts and the replay's inputs descend from one daemon; agreement among them shows internal consistency, not that the daemon computed what the code on this tree computes today (the three surviving May summaries matching today's rescan to 4 dp is the only cross-check, and it covers 3 of 9 pairs).

capability_contingency.era_bound_claim: Not era-bound: no model is in the loop. Spearman(sorted, sorted) = 1 and a thresholded statistic without a null fail identically in any era.
capability_contingency.what_would_move_it: Nothing on the model frontier. A fair test of the premise needs: a defined pairing relation or a two-sample spacing-distribution test (normalized gap distributions of the two subsets, not a rank correlation between unrelated orderings), a matched-marginal null with a published chance floor, seed replication over subsamples, and verdicts recorded with their p-values, over the same 9 pairs with expected-if-alive / expected-if-dead written before it runs. N1/N2 have already been executed against the corr_norm form and it is inside its own null; the two-sample test is the one artefact that would let the hypothesis die or live fairly. Each of those is a Frankenstein design question, not a capability question.

fair_test.scope: The whole run 2026-05-24..05-30 and every reading of it since; no window is clean because the instrument and design faults are in the code, not in the environment.
fair_test.finding: Pollux never tested its premise. The before/after-normalization contrast it was built on had a constant 'before' leg (T1/T2), the 'after' leg was thresholded without a null on the real marginals (N1/N2: PROMOTED recurs under independence up to 0.94) on a truncation the design never justified (T5), and no consumer could have validated a PROMOTED pair (Stygian stub). The 39 PROMOTED and 86 REJECTED verdicts -- counts now confirmed exactly -- are not evidence for or against spacing coincidences in Mahler subsets. This is epistemic: the general hypothesis has no defined test on the record; its only operationalized form is inside its own null; a fair test is specifiable (two-sample spacing-distribution test with matched-marginal null, published chance floor, seed replication, verdicts carrying p-values).

premise_exclusion: Not claimed. PREMISE_FAILURE / HYPOTHESIS_FAILURE would require a fair test that failed; none exists on the historical record, and a Necropolis-executed null cannot be filed as one (D-85).
NOT supported: 'Mahler subsets carry no spacing coincidence' -- never measured with a valid instrument; the general proposition has no defined test.

disposition.rationale: NO_FAIR_TEST_ON_RECORD retained from the Necromancer pass, on corrected grounds. The charter defines the class as 'the historical experiment could not have answered its own question'; the experiment could not because its 'before' leg was constant for ANY implementation of the design (T1, T2 incl. the non-sorting variant), its 'after' leg was thresholded without a null on marginals under which the PROMOTED verdict recurs up to 0.94 of the time (N2) and 0.44 / 0.33 / 0.13 for the pairs it promoted (N1), its truncation named a sub-population it never justified (T5), and its consumer was a stub (Stygian E9). DESIGN_ERROR is primary because those faults are the design's and survive any repair of the instrument; MEASUREMENT_ERROR and INSTRUMENT_ERROR are the same fact seen from the outcome column and are contributing. Chosen over TRUE_CORPSE because the general hypothesis has no defined test on the record and the doctrine cannot record the Necropolis-executed kill of its only operationalization (N1/N2) as a fair test. Chosen over CONSUMER_BLOCKED because the outputs were unusable before any consumer touched them. Chosen over NO_DESIGN_FAILURE_ESTABLISHED because the design failures are established by executed evidence. ADJUDICATION (Rhadamanthus, 2026-09-11, after CLERIC.md C-0..C-9): C-1, C-2, C-4, C-5, C-6, C-7, C-8 accepted after the Keeper re-read the cited result files (T2 per pair; N1/N2/D per pair; S1-S3b) and the daemon source. C-3 RULED BY EXECUTION, against the Cleric: the Keeper ran the settling query the Cleric proposed (one read-only GROUP BY on the second channel) and the channel carries 86/39/161 exactly as both readers reported; the Cleric's pre-registered prediction (62/63/161 if the code wrote the ledger) lost, and so did the Necromancer's 'unreproducible' -- both replays removed a settled pair from the rotation unconditionally where daemon.py removes it only while a replacement exists. A corrected replay reproduces every per-pair count at a unique v0.5 prefix of 47 ticks, and the tick times put the v0.6 deploy within two minutes of its commit. EXECUTION therefore stays VALID with the narrowed finding the Cleric asked for and the record-loss charged to D-67. Rulings: (i) primary_cause is the cause of the question being unanswerable (D-62 ruling carried over), which the charter's own definition puts on DESIGN; the 'deepest INVALID' rule is withdrawn (D-83); (ii) HYPOTHESIS NOT_EXAMINED with the N1/N2 result in the finding, because VALID meant 'well-posed' and the record shows no well-posed form (D-84); (iii) IMPLEMENTATION INVALID non-load-bearing on two real bugs, one found on this pass (pool-exhaustion path), neither contributing; (iv) P69 and the 06-24 dossier stay PARTIALLY_UPHELD with their census recorded as exactly right (D-78: the enum has no 'UPHELD with one error'); (v) the Necromancer fork's and the Cleric fork's shared modelling error is recorded against the Keeper's own lane in calibration/LEDGER.md -- two adversarial passes converged on the same false claim from the same untested assumption, which is the reader-divergence failure the META-TEST exists to catch. Stronger conclusion NOT supported: that the Mahler spacing-coincidence hypothesis is dead (TRUE_CORPSE / HYPOTHESIS_FAILURE). The record supports the narrower statement that its only operationalized form is inside its own null and that the general form has no test. A discriminating Frankenstein counterfactual is warranted (DESIGN ONLY: the two-sample spacing-distribution test in capability_contingency). No Zombie authorised.
